skills.name: azure-deploy
skills.purpose: Executes Azure deployments (azd up, etc.) for already-prepared apps; pairs with azure-prepare (scaffold azure.yaml/Bicep/Terraform) and azure-validate.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'deploy to Azure' once .azure/deployment-plan.md exists; requires Azure CLI/azd and an Azure subscription.
skills.evidence: Official Microsoft; skills.sh 617.5k installs (azure-skills pack 15.4M total)
skills.notes: Use azure-prepare first for new apps.

skills.name: azure-diagnostics
skills.purpose: Debugs Azure production issues using AppLens, Azure Monitor and resource health (App Service, Container Apps, Functions, AKS).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Azure troubleshooting requests; needs Azure CLI login.

skills.name: azure-app-onboard
skills.purpose: End-to-end orchestrator from an app idea or existing app to a running Azure deployment: detects services, scaffolds IaC, estimates cost, deploys after approval.
skills.how_to_use: Ask to bring an app to Azure; needs Azure subscription and azd/az CLI.
skills.evidence: Official Microsoft; new (Jul 24 2026), skills.sh 134K installs, trending #115

skills.name: cloudflare
skills.purpose: Entry point for the Cloudflare platform: picks the right products (Workers, KV, D1, R2, Durable Objects, AI, networking, security) and routes to detailed docs/skills.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on any Cloudflare architecture/product question. `npx skills add cloudflare/skills`.
skills.evidence: Official Cloudflare; skills.sh 107.8k installs; in VoltAgent list; skills.sh trending #155

skills.name: wrangler
skills.purpose: Runs and troubleshoots Wrangler CLI commands and Worker project config for local dev, previews, deploys and resource management.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on wrangler/Workers deploy tasks; needs Wrangler + Cloudflare account.
skills.evidence: Official Cloudflare; skills.sh 104.9k installs; skills.sh trending #158

skills.name: workers-best-practices
skills.purpose: Production best practices for writing, reviewing and configuring Cloudflare Workers.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing or reviewing Worker code/config.
skills.evidence: Official Cloudflare; skills.sh 97.6k installs; skills.sh trending #160

skills.name: durable-objects
skills.purpose: Build, debug or review Cloudflare Durable Objects for persistent state and coordination.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Durable Objects code; needs wrangler.

skills.name: deploy-to-vercel
skills.purpose: Deploys apps and sites to Vercel, including preview deployments, returning the live link.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'deploy my app' / 'push this live'. Needs Vercel CLI/account (see vercel-cli-with-tokens for token auth).
skills.notes: No LICENSE file (README says MIT) -> link-only.

skills.name: terraform-skill
skills.purpose: Diagnose-first Terraform/OpenTofu best practices: modules, tests, CI, security scanning, state ops, version-aware guard tables and LLM-mistake checklists.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing, reviewing or debugging Terraform/OpenTofu code.
skills.evidence: By Anton Babenko (terraform-aws-modules); 2.4k stars; skills.sh 6.7k installs; highlighted in hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code as most authoritative IaC skill

skills.name: terraform-style-guide
skills.purpose: Generates Terraform HCL following HashiCorp's official style conventions and best practices.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing, reviewing or generating Terraform configurations.
skills.evidence: Official HashiCorp; skills.sh 11.8k installs; in VoltAgent list

skills.name: cloud-run-basics
skills.purpose: Manages Google Cloud Run services, jobs and worker pools: deploy containers/source, configure scaling, traffic and env.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Cloud Run deployment tasks; needs gcloud CLI and a GCP project.

skills.name: firebase-app-hosting-basics
skills.purpose: Deploys and manages SSR web apps (Next.js, Angular) on Firebase App Hosting: apphosting.yaml, secrets, GitHub CI/CD, billing setup.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on App Hosting deploys; needs Firebase CLI and Blaze plan.
skills.evidence: Official Firebase; skills.sh 158K installs, on Hot list this week

skills.name: gcloud-app-deploy
skills.purpose: Deploys a Next.js or Node app to Cloud Run behind Firebase Hosting: standalone Docker build, domain rewrite, env vars, GitHub Actions via Workload Identity Federation, and fixes for common gcloud failures.
skills.how_to_use: Needs gcloud and firebase CLIs and a Google Cloud project.
skills.evidence: Written by the Skill Garden author from shipped work; cleaned public copy, MIT (3 Oct 2026).

skills.name: gke-basics
skills.purpose: Core GKE operations: cluster provisioning, credentials, Autopilot vs Standard selection and basic workload management.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on GKE cluster tasks; needs gcloud + kubectl.

skills.name: github-actions-templates
skills.purpose: Production-ready GitHub Actions workflows for testing, building and deploying, including reusable workflows and matrix builds.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.purpose: Sets up CI/CD pipelines with quality gates, test runners in CI, and deployment strategies (preview envs, rollbacks, feature flags).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating or changing build/deploy pipelines.

skills.name: kubernetes-specialist
skills.purpose: Kubernetes deployment and operations: manifests, pod security, service accounts, network policies, debugging crashes and resource limits.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when deploying/managing/debugging K8s workloads.

skills.name: terraform-test
skills.purpose: Writing and running Terraform native tests (.tftest.hcl): run blocks, assertions, provider mocking, module tests.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating Terraform test files or test scenarios.

skills.name: docker-patterns
skills.purpose: Docker and Compose patterns for local dev, container security, networking, volumes and multi-service orchestration.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating or reviewing Dockerfiles/Compose services.

skills.name: k8s-security-policies
skills.purpose: Kubernetes security: NetworkPolicies, Pod Security Standards, RBAC for production clusters.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when hardening clusters or enforcing pod security.

skills.name: grafana-dashboards
skills.purpose: Builds production Grafana dashboards for system and application metrics (panels, variables, alerting, provisioning).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when building monitoring dashboards.

skills.name: aws-iam
skills.purpose: Official AWS skill with verified corrections for IAM behaviours agents often get wrong (policy evaluation, trust policies, permission boundaries, SCPs) plus references.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing or debugging IAM policies/roles; part of aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws (installable as the aws-core plugin).
skills.evidence: Official AWS (new Apr 2026 toolkit); skills.sh ~9k installs
skills.notes: Same skill also shipped at plugins/aws-core/skills/aws-iam.

skills.name: aws-containers
skills.purpose: Official AWS skill for building and deploying containers on EKS, ECS, Fargate and ECR, including Karpenter and the AWS Load Balancer Controller.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on EKS/ECS/Fargate deployment work; requires AWS CLI credentials for live actions.
skills.notes: Toolkit also has aws-serverless, aws-observability, aws-cdk; the existing awslabs/agent-plugins aws-lambda entry may be superseded by this repo.

skills.name: opentelemetry
skills.purpose: Instruments apps with OpenTelemetry (Go, Java, Python, Node, .NET) and ships metrics/logs/traces to Grafana Cloud or self-hosted Mimir/Loki/Tempo.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on OTel instrumentation/observability setup; Grafana stack optional but assumed as backend.

skills.name: docker-build-strategies
skills.purpose: Writing/optimizing Dockerfiles: multi-stage builds, layer caching, .dockerignore, non-root and production hardening.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when an image is too large, builds are slow, or a container needs hardening.

skills.name: aws-lambda
skills.purpose: Design, build, deploy, test and debug serverless apps on AWS Lambda with event sources, API Gateway, EventBridge and Step Functions.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Lambda/serverless phrases; needs AWS credentials + SAM/CDK tooling.
skills.notes: Sibling skill 'deploy' (deploy-on-aws) deploys any codebase to AWS.

skills.name: aws-cdk-development
skills.purpose: AWS CDK expert for TypeScript/Python stacks and constructs, with CloudFormation/IaC best practices.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating CDK stacks/constructs; needs AWS CDK CLI and credentials.
